title: Battery recycling in Europe could reach EUR 1.2 billion by 2025
text: A forecast published this week expects the European EV battery recycling market to reach EUR 1.2 billion by 2025, growing about 30% a year from a small base. The forecast assumes cobalt prices stay near their 2022 highs and that the first large wave of end-of-life EV packs arrives by 2025.
